input: exactly writer,reader,mode,csv; writer literal/v1/v2; reader v1/v2; mode name/position-fault
csv_bounds: UTF-8 <=1024 bytes, 1 header + 1..4 nonblank data records, <=5 columns; no BOM; default excel dialect strict=True; LF/CRLF supported
headers: duplicate/empty/unknown/missing-required reject before typed conversion; any unique known column order accepted
integer: ASCII 0 or [1-9][0-9]? (0..99); no signs, blanks, leading zero, decimal or whitespace
optional: v2 missing note header => explicit (default); present empty note => empty string; absent cell under present note header => reject
note: ASCII text incl comma quote CR LF, <=16 characters
shape: extra or missing cells reject whole file; no partial committed rows
fault: position-fault assigns first required three positions to id,quantity,unit_price and fourth optional to note; header policy still checked; reordered same-type numeric cells can parse yet swap meaning
writer: v1/v2 actual DictWriter/StringIO emission must byte-equal supplied csv, otherwise input_refused; literal uses supplied fixture/custom bytes
claims: own typed policy, no general CSV version compatibility or RFC/schema standard conformance
